explanation: The statement concerns `TopModuleCat.restrictScalarsInt`, a functor defined in this very library (TauCeti/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Topology/RestrictScalars.lean, line 61) whose `map` is by definition `ofHom (f.hom.restrictScalars ℤ)`. Grepping Mathlib for `restrictScalarsInt` and for `TopModuleCat` shows Mathlib has no such functor and no lemma computing its action on morphisms; the result is a definitional-unfolding (`rfl`) fact about a library-local definition, so there is nothing in Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core with the same content.
